skills.name: On the Lam
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates after landing 120 normal attacks. Affects self. Concealment: Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks for 10 sec. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit. Critical Rate ▲ 8.98% for 3 sec. ■ Activates after performing 10 normal attacks. Affects the 2 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK. Removes 1 buff(s). Activates 1 time(s) per battle.

skills.name: Capo dei Capi
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. Concealment: Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks for 5 sec. This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit. ■ Activates when a Nikke is incapacitated. Affects self. Frenzy: ATK ▲ 12.83%, stacks up to 10 time(s) and lasts for 30 sec. Fills Burst Gauge by 20.54%.

skills.name: Vendetta
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Prioritizes Attacker-type enemies. Affects 2 unit(s). Deals 720.72% of final ATK as damage. ■ Activates if the skill user is in the Concealment state. Affects the same target(s). Deals 308.88% of final ATK as additional damage.
